messages:
anna: Heads-up — QuietBridge cutover is scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quick async check: who still has open network items or CRs?

liz: Confirming milestones: 08:30 smoke test start, 09:00 traffic shift, 10:00 rollback window close. I can own stakeholder comms.

michael: Firewall team: still waiting on QuietBridge CIDR allow from their infra team. I pinged them at 14:12 PT, no reply yet.

sam: On air-gap: Secure transfer package ready, but need final hostlist for the bastion. Can someone drop updated hostnames?

anna: @sam — hostlist attached in last handoff doc (see /docs/quietbridge/hosts.txt) but we had two extra nodes added this week. michael, can you confirm NAT for those?

michael: NAT yes, but need the public egress IP to be added to their ACL: 34.201.45.210. Also opening port 8443 for management plane.

sam: ack — I'll add the hosts and verify checksums after transfer. plan: scp package -> bastion -> internal repo.

ravi: Runbook note: Canary will hit a subset of tenants (5%) for first 15m. ops-runbook has the probe thresholds. If latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive mins, auto-fallback triggers.

anna: Quick code-review ping: the changes to private-deploy helm chart are in PR #6789 — @michael and @ravi can you review? It's small: image tag bump + extra initContainer for cert sync.

michael: Reviewing now. Left a small nit about the liveness probe path.

ravi: Took a look — lgtm pending probe fix. One question on secrets: are we using customer KMS or our proxy?

anna: Customer KMS via gateway — CI pipeline updated in #6790. That PR has the KMS role mapping.

michael: Also, network smoke: adding this /etc/hosts tweak in bootstrap to avoid DNS flaps, snippet below:

```
# temporary override for quietbridge nodes
34.201.45.210 quietbridge-bastion.qb.internal
34.201.45.211 qb-node-1.qb.internal
```

michael: Will remove after DNS TTL settles.

liz: Ops checklist status: runbook ok, monitors set, oncall assigned (ravi). Customer point-of-contact confirmed.

ravi: I'll be oncall 08:00-12:00 PT. If anything weird, ping me in #incidents and mark as "QuietBridge-cutover".

anna: Outstanding blockers: (1) customer ACL update (michael chasing), (2) PR #6789 probe fix, (3) final hostlist confirmation (sam). If all green by EOD, proceed.

michael: Chased ACL owner again — they replied, change will be applied tonight at 22:00 PT.

sam: Hostlist updated and checksum passed. Transfer dryrun successful.

devops-bot: deploy-checklist generated: items 1..12. All automated checks passed except live-probe lint.

anna: OK — plan: if ACL is applied and PR merged, we go ahead. I'll post a final preflight at 20:30 PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

liz: Thanks — will monitor comms.

michael: PR merged at 19:05 PT (fixed probe).

anna: Last call — anything else?

ravi: nothing from me. good luck.

anna: closing out here, will post final at 20:30.
